subject: Edge Onboarding: Mutual Action Plan & POC connectivity closure
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Edge Onboarding: Mutual Action Plan & POC connectivity closure

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I've sketched a short MAP focused only on the POC connectivity items we agreed are blockers for an initial evaluation run: org provisioning, API key exchange, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. I've attached a one-sheet (Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a quick network sketch.

Proposed minimal timeline (all tentative):
- Day 0 (today): Kickoff and sign-off on MAP owners (Helix: Samantha / Raj; Redwood: Mateo / Hannah).
- Day 1–2: Org create + RBAC (Helix creates an org-scoped service account; Redwood provides onboarding guide).
- Day 3: API key issuance (Helix provides ephemeral key window; Redwood to validate token scope).
- Day 4–5: IP allowlist confirmation (Helix to provide public egress IP CIDR list).
- Day 7: VPC peering request formalized (Jira + peering-request-template.json), target window in week 2 for peering test.

Open questions I flagged in the MAP: whether Helix wants the API keys short-lived (recommended) and whether traffic will route via a single Egress IP or multiple subnets (impacts allowlist).

Next actions: If this timeline looks good, can you confirm owners and whether your infra team prefers a Monday peering window (May 27) or Tuesday (May 28)? We'll set the DocuSign for the MAP agreement if you want formal sign-off.

Short and focused — we can expand the MAP to include journaling/retention rules after connectivity is green.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx, poc-network-sketch.png
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge Onboarding: Mutual Action Plan & POC connectivity closure

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. This looks very actionable. A few clarifications from our side:

1) API keys: we prefer short-lived tokens (12 hour window) for the POC. Can Redwood issue tokens compatible with rotating secrets (we use HashiCorp Vault)?
2) IP allowlist: our egress currently uses two NAT gateways across AZs (35.201.128.0/26 and 35.201.129.0/26). Is that acceptable or do you need a single IP?
3) VPC peering: we need a peering request template filled out with route tables; we'll create a ticket once you confirm the template fields.

Owners: Samantha Lee (Infra lead) and Raj Patel (Network). Both are ok for a May 28 peering window — Tues looks better for us.

One request: can you add a quick bullet in the MAP for the production-like sample traffic we should run post-peering? We want to validate both small chat requests and a bursty embedding pipeline.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the loops.
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Infra, Helix Health
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge Onboarding: Mutual Action Plan & POC connectivity closure

Samantha — thanks, great notes. Quick answers inline and updates to the MAP attached.

On Tue, May 21, 2029 at 09:37 AM Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixhealth.com> wrote:
> 1) API keys: we prefer short-lived tokens (12 hour window) for the POC. Can Redwood issue tokens compatible with rotating secrets (we use HashiCorp Vault)?

Yes — Redwood supports short-lived API keys via our onboarding flow. We can emit a one-time bootstrap key that your Vault can exchange for ephemeral tokens. Hannah will lead the integration steps (see task 2.1 in the MAP).

> 2) IP allowlist: our egress currently uses two NAT gateways across AZs (35.201.128.0/26 and 35.201.129.0/26). Is that acceptable or do you need a single IP?

Two CIDRs are fine; we'll add both to our inbound firewall rules. Note: if you later move to an outbound egress appliance with single IP we can consolidate.

> 3) VPC peering: we need a peering request template filled out with route tables; we'll create a ticket once you confirm the template fields.

Attached peering-request-template.json includes the fields we need (local/remote CIDRs, route tables, acceptance window). Please fill and return; Jonas will shepherd the RFC on the Redwood side.

About the post-peering validation traffic: good call. I've added a small verification checklist in the MAP:
- 10 sequential chat requests at 16 tokens/sample; verify <120ms p95 latency.
- One 1,000-request embedding burst at 64-dim model profile to validate batching (confirm throughput and no throttles).
- KV cache warmup test: 5 warm requests to check prefix cache effectiveness.

Next steps (updated):
- Thu, May 23: Hannah to send API key exchange steps + Vault hint doc.
- Tue, May 28: VPC peering window (Helix infra to initiate).
- Wed, May 29: Validation run and final close meeting.

If that schedule works Hannah, can you confirm you'll share the onboarding guide tomorrow morning?

—Mateo
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge Onboarding: Mutual Action Plan & POC connectivity closure

Hi all —

Confirmed: I will publish the Vault exchange snippet and the short-lived token flow by EOD today. Quick notes:
- We'll provide a bootstrap key in the DocuSign package so Helix can seed Vault; the bootstrap key expires in 72 hours.
- For the IP allowlist we have no objections to both NAT CIDRs you listed. Please include the exact CIDRs in the filled peering-request-template.json so our infra can pre-stage routes.
- Peering acceptance: Redwood will accept the peering during the scheduled window and perform a light smoke check (handshake + health endpoint). If smoke passes, we'll run the validation checklist Jonas outlined with the Helix test team.

Attached: (1) short snippet for Vault exchange; (2) updated MAP with task owners.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Edge Onboarding: Mutual Action Plan & POC connectivity closure

Hi Samantha / Raj —

Thanks for confirming owners and the May 28 peering window. I've scheduled our internal peering slot 2029-05-28 09:00–11:00 PT and added the acceptance checklist to the ticket. Please upload the completed peering-request-template.json to the HubSpot deal (link in MAP) and I'll route it to networking for pre-checks.

Quick reminder for Helix: include the two NAT egress CIDRs and the route table IDs you expect us to modify. We'll attempt the handshake during the first hour and run the validation suite in the second hour. If anything fails we'll revert routes and open a postmortem doc.

Looking forward — if there are no objections I will mark the MAP as locked and send the DocuSign link by close of day so we can exchange the bootstrap key.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
